I did not check the other candidate pairs, `range_fInf`/`range_fFin` and the two `*_mem_range_*_iff` lemmas, against any sources. They are short mirrored proofs, so I did not report them. I could not compile any proposed replacement. The exact elaboration of the suggested rewrites, for example `SpecMap_cancel` with the implicit universe levels or the defeq `⟨jFull N,_⟩ = jChartFin N ℓ`, is untested. haveI : Mono (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S.R S.K)) :=
    ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective _ (IsFractionRing.injective S.R S.K)
findings.problem: The proof of `m₁ = m₂` inlines the whole argument of the file's own lemma `SpecMap_cancel`. That argument is: `Spec.map_preimage` rewriting, `Spec.map_comp`, `Spec.map_injective`, `cancel_mono`, then rewriting back. The lemma sits at lines 199-205 and is already used in `hasLift_of_chartDatum` (line 246). The block is a non-trivial piece of Spec/Mono bookkeeping, now written out twice.
findings.proposed_change: Delete the `haveI : Mono …` line and the `hm` proof. Replace them with `have hm : m₁ = m₂ := SpecMap_cancel (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S.R S.K)) (IsFractionRing.injective S.R S.K) m₁ m₂ hF`. Here `R := of S.R`, `K := of S.K` and `Y := of A`, and `hF` is exactly the hypothesis `Spec.map j ≫ u = Spec.map j ≫ v`. Both users then rely on one proof. The finishing `ext; rw [← e₁, ← e₂, hm]` is unchanged.
findings.benefit: This removes about seven lines of fiddly categorical rewriting and leaves one place to maintain the 'Spec of an injective map is epi on maps into Spec' argument. The uniqueness proof then reads as: lift through the chart, cancel on the generic point, done.

findings.problem: Three places finish by applying `hasLift_of_chartDatum` to `mem_range_of_isIntegral` with a one-element generating set `{x}`, `subset_chartAlg N ℓ _` and `le_rfl`. Each then repeats `intro t ht; rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ht; subst ht` before the actual argument. They are lines 352-357 (generator `jFull N`, chart Fin), 386-393 (generator `(jFull N)⁻¹`, chart Inf) and 407-414 (the same, in the Inf-only case). Only the final one or two lines differ.
findings.proposed_change: Add one lemma next to `mem_range_of_isIntegral`, for example `hasLift_of_chartDatum_of_generator (S) (A) (ι) (D : ChartDatum S A ι) (x : FN) (hxA : {x} ⊆ (A : Set FN)) (hA : A ≤ chartAlg N ℓ {x}) (hx : D.g.hom ⟨x, hxA rfl⟩ ∈ (algebraMap S.R S.K).range) : S.commSq.HasLift`. Prove it by `hasLift_of_chartDatum S A ι D (mem_range_of_isIntegral S A ι D {x} hxA hA (by rintro t rfl; exact hx))`. Then the three uses become `hasLift_of_chartDatum_of_generator S _ _ D (jFull N) (subset_chartAlg N ℓ _) le_rfl hj`. For the Inf chart, use `(jFull N)⁻¹` with `hinv ▸ …` in one case and `hj0 ▸ zero_mem _` in the other.
findings.benefit: Each caller is reduced to the mathematical content, 'the generator maps into the valuation ring'. The `Set.mem_singleton_iff`/`subst` plumbing and the `change … ∈ _` coercions disappear from all three sites. If the integrality criterion changes (for example to a different generating set), only one lemma needs to be adapted.

findings.declaration: chartDatumOfMem (same factoring as liftStruct_eq_of_mem_range and false_of_liftStruct_cross)
findings.excerpt:
refine ⟨Spec.preimage (IsOpenImmersion.lift ι S.i₁ H), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Spec.map_preimage]; exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
findings.problem: Factoring a morphism out of a local spectrum through an affine open chart is done three times. `chartDatumOfMem` proves the range inclusion by hand, using `Subsingleton.elim` on the closed point (lines 223-226), and then takes `Spec.preimage (IsOpenImmersion.lift …)`. Its `fac` is proved by `rw [Spec.map_preimage]; exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _`. `liftStruct_eq_of_mem_range` redoes the range step through `range_subset_of_closedPoint_mem` and then the lift (lines 444-449). `false_of_liftStruct_cross` builds `G₁`, `G₂` and the factorisations `e₁`, `e₂` as two verbatim copies of the same `Spec.preimage`/`lift_fac` pair (the `G₁/e₁` and `G₂/e₂` blocks around lines 468-475). The helper `range_subset_of_closedPoint_mem` is placed in the Uniqueness section, so the Existence section cannot use it and keeps its own variant.
findings.proposed_change: Move `range_subset_of_closedPoint_mem` before `ChartDatum`. Add a lemma such as `exists_spec_map_factor {R : Type} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] {A : Type} [CommRing A] (l : Spec (CommRingCat.of R) ⟶ X₀) (ιA : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ X₀) [IsOpenImmersion ιA] (h : l.base (closedPoint R) ∈ Set.range ιA.base) : ∃ g : CommRingCat.of A ⟶ CommRingCat.of R, Spec.map g ≫ ιA = l`. The proof is `range_subset_of_closedPoint_mem`, then `IsOpenImmersion.lift`, then `Spec.preimage`, with `lift_fac` and `Spec.map_preimage`. `chartDatumOfMem` takes its `g` from it for `R := S.K`. `false_of_liftStruct_cross` obtains `G₁, e₁, G₂, e₂` by `obtain` instead of four `let`/`have` blocks. `liftStruct_eq_of_mem_range` gets `m₁, m₂` the same way.
findings.benefit: The 'closed point in an open chart implies factoring through the chart' step is stated once. The ad hoc `Subsingleton.elim` range proof in `chartDatumOfMem` goes, and the cross lemma loses its mirrored `G`/`e` boilerplate. The reader can see that existence and uniqueness use the same factoring.
